finalText:
Migration's done. Twelve files were still calling `db.query` — `sla.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`, `returnService.js`, `couponService.js`, `cohort.js`, `supplier.js`, `shipment.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `session.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, and `refund.js` — each with a get, list, and update call. All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` and the unrelated `cache.query` calls were left alone on purpose. The repo's `verify.js` check passes clean.
